name: Bánovce nad Bebravou (Slovakia)
description: A blue field within a white border, the hoist half chequered blue and white in three rows, ending at the fly in a swallowtail whose notch reaches one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature B-1/1997.

features.role: blue field, white border, hoist half chequered blue and white
